status_note: The 38-line covered projection byte-matches Ghidra 12.0.4's CommentSorter shared-iterator machinery: findPosition's eight placement decisions, setupFunctionList's no-type-filter/pos-counter/setEmitted(false) lifecycle, setupBlockList/setupOpList/setupHeader lower_bound/upper_bound windowing, and hasNext/getNext interleaved consumption across successive op landmarks. Overall remains MISMATCH for three representation residuals: Rugra has no BlockBasic cover RangeList (contains is projected from [start_addr, last-op addr]), the sorter clones placed Comments instead of holding database pointers (setEmitted(false) does not propagate into CommentDatabaseInternal). The printc-glue-snapshot residual is CLOSED: printc.rs consumers now drive the state machine directly (emit_comment_group covers the setupOpList(NULL) arm), integrated as c5e685c.

rugra_source.rust_overlay: Archive Rugra base c5e685c55e775192dae7b26f0631f6ac8ff85df6 and overlay only the owned src/comment.rs candidate before the isolated offline build

architecture.spaces: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5; byte addressed
architecture.type_factory: one architecture-owned factory with canonical xunknown1/2/4/8; only needed to satisfy the Funcdata constructor

compiler_spec.calling_convention: empty input/output records; no effects, symbols, or injections

analysis_options.api: Direct production CommentSorter::setupFunctionList/setupBlockList/setupOpList/setupHeader and hasNext/getNext calls; no PrintC, Action, or Rule pipeline
analysis_options.funcdata: One synthetic Funcdata per sorter run; five BlockBasic blocks (chain bb_a->bb_b->bb_c->bb_d->bb_e) whose reverse-post-order indexes come from the production BlockGraph::findSpanningTree port on both sides; eleven COPY ops created and inserted in one fixed mirrored order (creation order fixes SeqNum::uniq, insertion order fixes the BlockBasic::insert order ladder); two additional Funcdata runs for the dead-op and op-less cases
analysis_options.ir: Ops carry addresses only; no Varnodes, inputs, or outputs. Block covers use Funcdata::setBasicBlockRange with end == the last op's address, matching Rugra's [start_addr, last-op addr] projection; bb_c degenerates to a single-address range
analysis_options.normalization: None. The emitted projection uses exact comment type numbers, emitted flags, texts, per-walk ordinals, and drained counts; no ID, order, or state normalization
analysis_options.random_seed: none; construction and walks are deterministic
analysis_options.error_injection: one dead op (created but never block-inserted) whose findPosition probing raises the oracle LowlevelError text

observation_schema.format: 38 fixed-order UTF-8 lines with final newline: one banner, then per-walk records (one line per emitted comment with type/emitted/text and per-walk n ordinal, one drained-count terminator per walk), the dead-op error line, and the op-less walk
observation_schema.placement_decisions: Every findPosition branch is discriminated by which walk emits the comment and at which landmark: header-at-entry, op lower-bound containment, previous-op 0xffffffff tail, migrated backupOp, op-less (0,0), excised drop
observation_schema.iterator_state: hasNext/getNext interleaving is observed as drained counts per landmark: successive setupOpList calls narrow opstop while start persists, so only comments between landmarks appear; setupOpList(NULL) flushes the block remainder through stop
observation_schema.lifecycle: emitted=0 on every walked comment (setupFunctionList's setEmitted(false)); type numbers and texts are exact

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: MATCH: Subsort keys mutate in place with pos preserved across findPosition calls; commmap insert-or-assign under unique pos keys; dead-op LowlevelError text identical; the excised comment is absent from every walk. Residual: db-side setEmitted(false) mutation is not observable through Rugra's cloned Comments.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: MATCH: setupFunctionList walks the database range for the function address in (addr, uniq) order over every comment regardless of the tp mask; findPosition probes the PcodeOpTree lower bound and, when applicable, its predecessor; all walks emit in (index, order, pos) order.
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: MATCH: subsort.pos initialized to 0 once before the loop, incremented only for placed comments, persisting across iterations; per-walk n ordinals restart at 1; drained counts accumulate per setup* window.
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: MATCH: Subsort orders by signed int4 index (-1 header before block indexes), then uint4 order, then uint4 pos; setupBlockList bounds [lower_bound((bl,0,0)), upper_bound((bl,MAX,MAX))]; setupOpList upper_bound((bl,order,MAX)); setupHeader bounds over (-1,headerType,*); lower/upper bounds reproduce std::map rank semantics via sorted-vector partition points.
